purpose: Prepare a deterministic workflow-readiness package with measurable reliability, ownership, recovery, and compatibility boundaries without activating an integration or mutating an account.

objective_signals: The objective concerns a repeated stable cross-service transport, schema mapping, operational data-quality burden, or recovery gap.
prerequisites: One stable workflow requirement names canonical source and destination owners, schemas, authority, retention, measurable burden, and an internal-only activation boundary.

nodes.objective: Bind one stable transport problem, canonical owners, authority, data boundary, reliability target, non-goals, resource cap, and stop rule.
Validate the current workflow baseline, lineage, volume, error classes, missingness, manual burden, reporting window, and measurable reliability guardrails.

Produce an internal workflow-readiness package covering owners, schemas, idempotency, finite retries, quarantine, readback, permissions, recovery, compatibility, test evidence, risks, and inactive status.

Review the exact workflow-readiness package for canonical ownership, authority, privacy, idempotency, bounded recovery, compatibility, test evidence, inactive state, and no-account-mutation compliance.
